products.title: Mr. Pen – Bloom in the Bible Journaling Kit, Bible Journaling Gift Set with Highlighters, Pens, Stickers, Tabs & More

description.html: Created in Partnership with @SheLovesBible: The Bloom in the Bible Kit was thoughtfully designed to help you flourish in your faith. Whether you're a seasoned Bible journaler or just beginning your journey, this kit encourages deeper, more creative time in God’s Word. Everything You Need for Meaningful Reflection: Includes 8 gel highlighters that won’t bleed through thin Bible pages, 6 smooth black pens, a fine liner pen for sticky notes, 3 washi tapes, 14 floral sticker sheets, and more. Layered, Intentional Journaling: Transparent sticky notes (in round and rectangular shapes) let you reflect directly over scripture without covering it—perfect for layering prayers, insights, or sermon notes. Beautifully Organized & Gift-Ready: With Bible tabs, floral paper clips, and a coordinating Bible pouch, everything stays neat, accessible, and beautifully bundled—ideal for gifting or personal study time. Floral Aesthetic That Grounds You in Scripture: Delicate designs meet spiritual purpose. From the blooms on the stickers to the soft pastels of the tools, this kit helps turn your quiet time into a creative, Christ-centered habit. Optional Bloom in the Bible ESV Journaling Bible: A beautifully crafted hardcover Bible with the Bloom in the Bible theme printed on the front. Features the complete ESV text in a single-column format, thoughtfully designed to support slow, intentional reading and reflection. Includes a 1-year Bible reading plan and 2-inch ruled margins for journaling prayers, notes, and personal insights beside Scripture. Bound with smyth-sewn stitching for strength and flexibility—designed to lie flat for comfortable study and long-term use. Printed on cream-colored, high-quality Bible paper with a ribbon marker.

Floral Aesthetic That Grounds You in Scripture: Delicate designs meet spiritual purpose. From the blooms on the stickers to the soft pastels of the tools, this kit helps turn your quiet time into a creative, Christ-centered habit. Optional Bloom in the Bible ESV Journaling Bible: A beautifully crafted hardcover Bible with the Bloom in the Bible theme printed on the front. Features the complete ESV text in a single-column format, thoughtfully designed to support slow, intentional reading and reflection. Includes a 1-year Bible reading plan and 2-inch ruled margins for journaling prayers, notes, and personal insights beside Scripture. Bound with smyth-sewn stitching for strength and flexibility—designed to lie flat for comfortable study and long-term use. Printed on cream-colored, high-quality Bible paper with a ribbon marker.
